description: Ministry of Women and Child Affairs - Adoption of Children Ordinance (Chapter 61)
categorisation: This gazette contains a regulation made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs under the Adoption of Children Ordinance, which constitutes subsidiary legislation. It establishes a legal/regulatory framework by setting a numerical limit (100) on adoption orders for a specific category of applicants for the calendar year 2018. This fits the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for regulatory matters and statutory instruments.
